name: Bikaner
registryBasis: The Rajasthan Urban GIS portal advertises Khasra/plot layers and a City/ULB selector, and Bikaner Municipal Corporation publishes ward-boundary material and city property/plot statistics. technicalBlocker: No city-specific anonymous parcel feature schema was verified; direct HTTPS shell access to the public GIS timed out. No TLS bypass was attempted, no parcel query was performed, and no geometry retained.
scopeLimits: State Urban GIS public viewer and the Bikaner municipal portal were identified. Portal text lists Khasra and plot search controls, including parcel-specific selectors; no parcel, Khasra, or property query was submitted. Bikaner city GIS geometry and its schema were not verified.
remainingUncertainty: No complete georeferenced parcel polygon with a verified safe native ID was obtained for this city. Public maps or registry workflows may provide visual layers or identity-dependent services that were not queried.
